title: Why Does Organized Sound Make Us Feel Things?
question: Music has no survival-obvious content—no calories, no mates, no danger—so why does a sequence of pitches reliably produce chills, tears, or joy?
summary: Music is patterned air pressure with no inherent meaning, yet it moves people to tears in every culture on earth. An exploration of the leading theories for why, and why none of them fully close the case.
